tools.name: run_pg_amcheck_and_report
tools.description: Runs the pg_amcheck integrity checker against a PostgreSQL database to look for index and heap corruption. A summary of the findings is then posted to the given Slack webhook URL.

params.name: database
params.description: Name of the database to check.

params.name: slack_webhook_url
params.description: Slack incoming webhook URL that receives the summary.

params.name: schema
params.description: Limit the check to this schema.

params.name: heapallindexed
params.description: Also confirm that every heap tuple has a matching index entry. This is slower.

tools.name: drop_expired_partition
tools.description: Drops a time-based partition table from PostgreSQL for good, removing all of its rows. A notice naming the dropped partition is then posted to the given webhook URL.

params.name: partition_name
params.description: Partition table to drop, in the form schema.table_YYYY_MM.

params.name: webhook_url
params.description: Webhook URL that receives the drop notice.

tools.name: purge_audit_log_entries
tools.description: Permanently deletes audit log rows older than the given number of days from the SQLite audit database. Returns how many rows were removed.

params.name: db_path
params.description: Path to the SQLite audit database file.

params.name: older_than_days
params.description: Delete entries older than this many days. Must be at least 30.

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
from agents import function_tool


@function_tool
def purge_audit_log_entries(db_path: str, older_than_days: int) -> dict:
    result = {"db_path": db_path, "deleted_rows": 0, "cutoff": None, "ok": False}
    if older_than_days < 30:
        result["error"] = "older_than_days must be at least 30"
        return result
    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(days=older_than_days)).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute("DELETE FROM audit_log WHERE created_at < ?", (cutoff,))
        conn.commit()
        result["deleted_rows"] = cur.rowcount
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result["cutoff"] = cutoff
    result["ok"] = True
    return result

tools.name: grant_schema_role
tools.description: Grants an existing PostgreSQL role to a database user so the user gets the role's privileges on the schema. You can also let the user pass the role on to others.

params.name: dsn
params.description: PostgreSQL connection string for an account that can grant roles.

params.name: role_name
params.description: Existing role to grant, for example analytics_readonly.

params.name: username
params.description: Database user who receives the role.

params.name: with_admin_option
params.description: Let the user grant this role to others.
